The latest stable release v4.4.0 for Lean is out now!

The release brings:

  • import auto-completion
  • declaration renaming in VSCode
  • per-package server options (you can jump to definition from Mathlib to Std again!)
  • automatic guessing of lexicographic orders for well-founded recursion
    as well as many bug fixes to Lean and Lake.

We encourage everyone using previous stable releases to update their repositories to v4.4.0.

Std, Aesop, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.4.0

  • the stable branch on each repository has been updated to use v4.4.0
  • there is a v4.4.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.

Somehow mathlib4 cache no longer works for me after upgrading to v4.5.0-rc1. I suspect it's because mathlib4 should depend on ProofWidgets4 @ v0.0.24 instead of v0.0.24-pre2.
https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/58eef79b1520d17ff085f58b599690c112a47e6b/lakefile.lean#L32
